closure_law: An issue closes only when every acceptance gate has source-bound evidence, required commands are not skipped, independent review passes, and post-merge validation succeeds.

issues.title: Establish a truthful active-run control surface
issues.failure_mode: Current root agent instructions describe older single-agent/V29 and v9 runs. Agents may execute obsolete sequencing and completion rules.
issues.root_cause: Long-lived mutable prose has no source-bound active-run pointer.
evidence: AGENTS.md says no multi-agent coordination is required
PROMPT.md references older V5 audit tensor
CLAUDE.md targets an older v9 finish line
required_changes: Install this pack in an immutable run directory
Preserve prior instructions as superseded history
Create and validate run/state.json against the actual checkout
acceptance: Exactly one active run directory is named
Every agent receives pack path and task ID
issues.rollback: Restore the prior active-run pointer; preserve this run directory and logs.

issues.title: Preserve graph execution failures instead of returning Complete
issues.failure_mode: execute_with_interrupt maps non-interrupt errors to ExecutionResult::Complete with cloned state.
issues.root_cause: Interrupt control flow and ordinary failure share one error channel, and the public result has no preserved error path.
evidence: engine.rs contains an Err(_) => ExecutionResult::Complete(state_clone) equivalent
interrupt.rs documents Complete as normal completion
required_changes: Use a typed interrupt stop reason
acceptance: Compatibility adapter cannot recreate false success
issues.rollback: Keep a deprecated adapter to the new Result API; never restore false-success semantics.

issues.title: Make missing, malformed, contradictory, or unavailable governance fail closed
issues.failure_mode: Observation errors and absence collapse into a default all-false observation that resolves to Allow; malformed booleans become false.
issues.root_cause: Control value and observation quality share primitive boolean/default fields, and FailOpen is default.
required_changes: Carry quality and exception lineage into receipts
acceptance: Only a valid continuity exception can override
issues.rollback: Legacy fail-open may exist only behind a disabled-by-default explicit compatibility feature with receipts.

issues.title: Remove fake exact decoding and ignored codec dispatch
issues.failure_mode: Turbo/Fib decode helpers return encoded bytes unchanged; dispatch is ignored; Q8/Q4 become Uncompressed; strict_mode is inert.
issues.root_cause: Scaffolding was promoted into a production-facing semantic boundary without a real wire contract or backend registry.
required_changes: Return UnsupportedCodec until real decoder exists
acceptance: Compressed bytes cannot pass as exact output
issues.rollback: Disable compression and use authoritative raw vectors; never restore pass-through decoding.

issues.title: Make stack-ids the exclusive canonical ID type and construction authority
issues.failure_mode: IDs expose public String internals, infallible parsing, arbitrary construction, and generic UUID generation for all semantic families.
issues.root_cause: The crate centralizes type names but not lifecycle-specific invariants, provenance, or minting law.
acceptance: trybuild rejects tuple construction and unauthorized minting
issues.rollback: Dual-read/single-write with alias and supersession records; never reinterpret stored IDs destructively.

issues.title: Remove competing ID generators and raw canonical ID strings
issues.failure_mode: Multiple crates generate UUID/ULID IDs, define local *Id types, and expose public *_id: String fields.
issues.root_cause: No enforceable repository boundary prevents local identity systems.
required_changes: Add only truly cross-crate concepts to stack-ids
Keep DB-local keys local and typed
acceptance: No unallowlisted production uuid/ulid outside stack-ids
No unallowlisted public *Id definitions outside stack-ids
issues.rollback: Retain legacy columns/adapters for one compatibility window; new code writes canonical IDs plus aliases.

issues.title: Replace separator-based digest composition with typed length framing
issues.failure_mode: DigestBuilder uses a NUL separator, so embedded NUL can collide across field boundaries. Digest strings also have weak validation boundaries.
issues.root_cause: Structured digest domains are untyped concatenations instead of versioned framed encodings.
evidence: quant-codec-core length-prefix implementation is a partial reference
required_changes: Unify or clearly separate digest authorities
issues.rollback: Retain V1 verifier and append supersession mappings; never silently rewrite historical digests.

issues.title: Prevent lossy ScopeKey-to-legacy namespace collapse
issues.failure_mode: to_legacy_namespace returns only namespace even when domain/workspace/repo are present.
issues.root_cause: A lossy projection is exposed as an ordinary conversion without policy or error.
required_changes: Return Result and reject multidimensional scopes
Add explicit lossy policy for exceptional paths
issues.rollback: Keep old behavior only in a named deprecated lossy adapter after canonical dimensions are persisted.

issues.title: Make claim-ledger parsing, IDs, and completeness fail closed
issues.failure_mode: Malformed JSONL lines are dropped, serialization errors become empty strings, IDs use newline joining/truncation, and there is no anchored head receipt.
issues.root_cause: Convenience APIs erase material errors and a valid prefix is treated as a complete ledger.
required_changes: Strict Result parser with line/offset/prefix state
Canonical stack IDs and framed digests
acceptance: All ledger IDs use canonical authority
issues.rollback: Strict V1 reader plus V2 writer/head receipts; preserve original bytes and migration receipts.

issues.title: Create one codec/profile/wire contract for interchangeable backends
issues.failure_mode: Multiple VectorCodec traits, CodecId types, profile/digest formats, and score semantics require backend-specific integration.
issues.root_cause: Backends evolved independently and adapters became additional semantic authorities.
required_changes: Registry routes but does not invent semantics
acceptance: Backends swap without domain code changes
issues.rollback: Disable compressed backends and rebuild sidecars from authoritative raw vectors; retain versioned readers.

issues.title: Make ai-batch-queue claim and completion atomic
issues.failure_mode: next_queued clones without claiming; mark_running is separate; mark_completed can complete pending/running work; missing/poisoned state is often silent.
issues.root_cause: Mutex<Vec<Job>> is both store and scheduler without claim tokens or a strict state machine.
evidence: retry_failed can succeed on missing job
issues.rollback: Compatibility adapter may call new atomic operations; old scheduler only behind explicit feature.

issues.title: Make job-queue cancellation, heartbeat, lease, and DB concurrency explicit
issues.failure_mode: Cancellation errors become false, heartbeat errors are ignored, process_one nests errors inside Ok, and one mutexed connection serializes DB work.
issues.root_cause: Operational uncertainty is represented as benign state; spawn_blocking is mistaken for DB concurrency.
required_changes: Escalate heartbeat failure and lease loss
acceptance: Cancellation lookup failure cannot silently continue
Read concurrency is measured and not globally mutexed
issues.rollback: Preserve schema/ownership columns; connection strategy may revert without reverting stricter result semantics.

issues.title: Align semantic-memory search corruption behavior with strict integrity claims
issues.failure_mode: Brute-force search skips malformed embedding rows with warnings, silently returning incomplete results.
issues.root_cause: Availability policy is implicit and absent from result/receipt state.
evidence: crate docs claim malformed stored data is surfaced
search.rs warns and skips invalid embedding rows
required_changes: Strict fails on corrupt authoritative rows
Degraded is opt-in and receipts exact omissions/reasons
acceptance: Integrity and search use consistent decode
issues.rollback: Default strict; compatibility degraded path requires typed acceptance and receipt.

issues.title: Certify every required workspace and feature lane
issues.failure_mode: Principal gates deeply test a subset; nested workspaces and alternative feature backends are not independently certified; push trigger omits actual default branch.
issues.root_cause: Supported-lane evidence is interpreted as repository-wide certification.
acceptance: All supported feature configurations are explicit
issues.rollback: New CI may observe non-required briefly, but release remains blocked until required and green.

issues.title: Make lint policy mandatory or explicitly exempted
issues.failure_mode: Workspace lints are opt-in per package; panic scan is lane-scoped and text-based.
issues.root_cause: Root lint prose is treated as law without mechanical inheritance.
required_changes: Add workspace=true or exact expiring exemptions
acceptance: All required packages inherit or exempt
New member without inheritance fails gate
issues.rollback: Removing the lint gate also removes release-ready status; exemptions stay exact and expiring.

issues.title: Separate evidence recording from verification and bind receipts to source/environment
issues.failure_mode: Gate rewrites evidence it checks; checked-in evidence disagrees; receipts lack commit/tree/lock/toolchain/platform/workspace/command/log binding.
issues.root_cause: Mutable derivative evidence is treated as independent proof and verify has write side effects.
evidence: run_release_gates writes manifest then generates/checks receipt
audited evidence manifest records a fail
issues.rollback: Preserve old receipts as superseded history; never overwrite or delete command logs.

issues.title: Bind benchmark and readiness claims to reproducible evidence
issues.failure_mode: Measured JSON, projected binary, small fixture recall, and broad architecture claims are mixed and can read as production guarantees.
issues.root_cause: Documentation changed independently of a source-bound claims manifest and benchmark receipt.
evidence: latest audited commit adds 50x/100% recall wording
READMEs mix measured and projected values
acceptance: Every quantitative claim resolves to a receipt or is projected/paper-reported
Examples compile or are labeled pseudocode
issues.rollback: Revert to conservative nonclaims while preserving benchmark receipts.

issues.title: Optimize only after correctness with reproducible baselines
issues.failure_mode: String IDs, payload clones, linear queue scans, polling, one DB connection, and JSON materialization impose avoidable cost.
issues.root_cause: No unified performance budget or source-bound allocation/latency evidence.
required_changes: Streaming canonical serialization only after semantics freeze
issues.rollback: Isolate each optimization and preserve correctness-first fallback.
